records.title: NOVA-1 -- ho_mon intercept pays out before the cast is proven to exist: unfunded/adapter-declined casts open the window, protector pays 15 The + squishy mints externalWard(7500)+ho_ve marker + intercepted=true, then castBlocked; repeated dead casts drain the pool farming wards
